body.purpose: Short live status and transient messages.

motion.name: press-response
motion.purpose: Compress a camera control on touch and return it with a restrained spring.

motion.name: mode-glide
motion.purpose: Move the selected mode marker between positions.

elevation.strategy: Flat controls over the live preview; translucent scrims preserve readability. No component shadow system.

components.name: Camera control
components.description: A circular 48dp capability-aware top control with brass active state.
components.html: <button class="ds-control" aria-label="Camera control"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="7"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="2"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-control { width: 48px; height: 48px; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(21,21,20,.8); color: #fff; display: grid; place-items: center; transition: transform 90ms ease-out, color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-control svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-control:hover, .ds-control:focus-visible { color: #E2C58A; } .ds-control:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E2C58A; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-control:active { transform: scale(.9); }

components.name: Photo shutter
components.css: .ds-shutter { width: 82px; height: 82px; border: 4px solid #fff; border-radius: 50%; background: transparent; display: grid; place-items: center; transition: transform 90ms ease-out; } .ds-shutter span { width: 62px; height: 62px; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; } .ds-shutter:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E2C58A; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-shutter:active { transform: scale(.94); }

components.name: Mode rail
components.description: A compact capsule for supported Photo, Video, and Pro modes.
components.css: .ds-mode-rail { min-height: 48px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; padding: 2px; border-radius: 18px; background: rgba(17,17,16,.72); color: #B4B0A8; font: 500 13px/1 Roboto, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .16em; } .ds-mode-rail span { flex: 1; text-align: center; padding: 16px 10px; border-radius: 16px; } .ds-mode-rail .ds-mode-active { color: #E2C58A; background: rgba(51,43,30,.27); } .ds-mode-rail span:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E2C58A; }

components.name: Zoom selector
components.description: A translucent capsule of discovered zoom stops with a moving selection.
components.css: .ds-zoom { display: flex; gap: 4px; padding: 5px; border-radius: 32px; background: rgba(0,0,0,.5); } .ds-zoom button { min-width: 38px; height: 38px; padding: 0 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; color: #fff; background: transparent; font: 500 12px Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-zoom .ds-zoom-active { color: #E2C58A; background: rgba(255,255,255,.2); } .ds-zoom button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E2C58A; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Pro readout chip
components.description: A label-over-value chip for a real supported exposure parameter.
components.css: .ds-pro-chip { min-width: 56px; padding: 6px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #fff; display: grid; gap: 4px; text-align: center; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-pro-chip span { color: #B4B0A8; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: .14em; } .ds-pro-chip strong { color: #E2C58A; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-pro-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E2C58A; border-radius: 8px; }

narrative.overview:
The interface treats the phone as a capable camera instrument: the live scene is the work surface, and controls appear only where they help compose, expose, or capture it. A restrained obsidian field lets the viewfinder lead; satin brass marks active choices, pearl carries essential information, and recording red is reserved for video state.

Controls are direct, compact, and capability-aware. The system uses familiar Android touch behavior while drawing its custom camera controls in a precise, tactile visual language. The look is informed by flagship camera usability, not copied from another camera app.
keyCharacteristics: Satin-brass active states on a dark neutral field.
Recording red reserved for video capture state.
Modes and settings reflect capabilities reported by Camera2.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Brass means an active selection; recording red means video is recording. Do not use either as decoration.

rules.name: The Readout Rule
rules.body: Use tabular-feeling, concise values for exposure, zoom, timer, and recording state; do not turn technical values into decorative copy.

rules.name: The Scene-First Rule
rules.body: Keep chrome translucent and sparse; never place an opaque decorative panel over the viewfinder.

dos: Do keep the active scene as the dominant visual content.
Do show capture modes and settings only when the active camera reports support.
Do use brass for active state and recording red only for recording state.
Do make focus, exposure, and timer overlays appear only when their action is available.
donts: Don't claim software video stabilization; only advertised OIS/EIS requests are implemented.
Don't show a failed camera extension as an active mode.
Don't add decorative settings cards, gradients, or camera controls that do not change capture behavior; functional contrast scrims are allowed.
